task.description:
WF-03 Step 00: Git Setup for Issue Resolving — Issue #419 / ISS-0129

Create the feature branch from main, push it, and report the branch name back.

Procedure per docs/agents/protocols/GIT_SETUP.md:
  1. git checkout main
  2. git pull --ff-only origin main
  3. git checkout -b feature/WF03-gh419-20260805
  4. git push origin feature/WF03-gh419-20260805
  5. Verify: git branch --show-current == feature/WF03-gh419-20260805

Do NOT edit any source files in this step — only branch creation and push.

Background: GitHub issue tvolodi/R-Co#419 reports a C40P01 deadlock during
TC-TNT-01-01 re-provisioning. The issue's candidate_resolution points to
migration 1135 having a DROP TRIGGER — this is incorrect: migration 1135
contains only an INSERT...SELECT backfill of public.tenant and has no
DROP TRIGGER. The real deadlock source is migration 1107 / 1109 running
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash against an audit_entries
row currently held by a concurrent TC-TNT-03-01/03-03 insert. Step 1
diagnosis will pin this down precisely, but the feature branch must
already exist so Step 3 (implementation) commits to it.

Return PASS with the branch name, the SHA of the upstream main you based on,
and confirmation the push succeeded (look for '* [new branch]' in output).
acceptance_criteria: git push succeeds (visible 'new branch' on remote)
No source files modified in this step
